US Aviation System Seeks $50 Billion Upgrade

US Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg is seeking $50 billion to modernize the nation's aviation system. The push for upgrades comes after a nationwide ground stop, which highlighted concerns about aviation safety laws.
